Talk via Live Voice, complete daily challenges, and earn coins to climb from Rookie to 'Legend' status. Unlock exclusive Secret Match IDs to bridge your network with ChatSphere & TK Movies. Zero app store installs required—instant PWA power!

posts.name: Zapinner
posts.tagline: 79 data utilities. One API. Stop rebuilding the boring stuff
posts.description: Zapinner gives developers 79 production-ready data utilities through one API. Normalize messy data, detect duplicates, validate records, repair JSON, detect PII, reconcile sources, transform data, and more—without rebuilding the same utility code for every project. Use REST, SDKs, or connect AI agents through MCP. One integration, consistent structured responses, and a free tier to start.

posts.name: Kagazo
posts.tagline: Verify Gov PDF Digital Signatures Free & Productivity Tools
posts.description: Instantly fix government PDF digital signatures (green checkmark), resize exam photos for UPSC, TNPSC & SSC, create 5-in-1 A4 ID gang sheets, mask Aadhaar, and calculate home construction costs. 100% free, in-browser RAM privacy.

posts.name: Lacuna
posts.tagline: Flashcard App for the exam day.
posts.description: Lacuna is a spaced repetition app that uses FSRS to schedule for the exam date, rather than indefinitely like Anki. Lacuna works around you - the scheduler can be used at all times, rather than just when the flashcard is due - which means that you can squeeze studying into the time that's convenient, without sacrificing quality It has easy importing from Anki and also all the features that you need. It's fully offline and private, with no data sent anywhere unless you choose the opt in sync.

posts.name: DwellStamp
posts.tagline: Rental inspection records, organized room by room
posts.description: DwellStamp turns move-in and move-out walkthroughs into structured rental condition records. Capture photos and notes room by room, keep everything local on iPhone, and export a readable PDF plus original files in a ZIP. No account required. Free for one active property and one full export; unlimited use is a one-time $4.99 purchase.

posts.name: Gorbo
posts.tagline: Personalized greeting cards with absolutely no manners
posts.description: Gorbo turns your message into an absurd animated delivery. A rude purple creature prints it out of his backside, then leaves your friend a receipt. Choose a birthday roast, apology, love letter, debt reminder or petty court summons. Add names and your message, preview it free, then pay to create a shareable link. Recipients open it in their browser without installing an app. Save the receipt or export a vertical video.

posts.name: Whisty
posts.tagline: The quietest place to post in the world. No noises.
posts.description: Most places to write hand you a theme picker, a follower count, a feed. Whisty removes all of it. You get one page — yourname.whisty.org — for short thoughts and photos. Nothing to configure: the design is fixed, and your first line already looks right. What sets it apart is what will never exist: no likes, followers, view counts, feeds, algorithms, notifications. Not missing features — the charter rules them out for good. Public, so a passerby might read it. You will never be told.

posts.name: COMPScout
posts.tagline: Free React UI components & 58+ animated typography blocks .
posts.description: Discover a curated library of free, responsive React components, interactive Bento grid blocks, Tailwind CSS UI elements, and Next.js website templates. Elevate modern web development with COMPScout.

posts.name: SystemFoundry
posts.tagline: 1-click Figma AI-compliant design system generator
posts.description: SystemFoundry is a lightweight Figma plugin that generates 100% Figma AI-compliant design systems in 1 click. Create 103 documented variables, dual Light/Dark mode playgrounds, 19 token-bound components, and export CSS/Tailwind tokens instantly.

posts.name: Leadhunt AI
posts.tagline: Real-time AI lead scraping for any industry.
posts.description: LeadHunt AI is an AI-powered prospect intelligence tool for Web3 developers and projects. It helps you find and connect with key decision-makers in niches like Crypto Founders, Web3 Marketers, and DeFi Projects. Simply enter your target market, and get fresh, email-verified leads instantly. Start with your wallet address and pay with BNB Smart Chain credits. Perfect for accelerating growth with accurate, AI-driven lead data.

posts.name: Decode sugar cravings with sweetspotapp
posts.tagline: Decode sugar cravings playfully inside The Sweet Spot app
posts.description: Stop fighting cravings with willpower. The Sweet Spot takes a gentle, playful approach with our hero category: Sugar Rush. Craving Decoder: Pinpoint the real trigger behind your sweet tooth in seconds. Gamified Micro-Tools: Playful pauses to interrupt mindless snacking loops. Gentle Frameworks: Enjoy treats without steep energy crashes. Bonus: Explore 22 other built-in wellness mini-apps! No shame or food rules. Includes a full 2-week free trial.

posts.name: Track MyStory — the map of your life
posts.tagline: Timeline with multiple branches and add-ons (such as GitHub)
posts.description: Track MyStory allows you to track your life’s timeline across multiple parallel branches. A key feature is its ability to integrate with platforms like GitHub, enabling you to link life events with project development and view progress across everything at a glance.

posts.name: UNIVERSAL File Converter
posts.tagline: Convert files locally on Windows without sketchy websites
posts.description: UNIVERSAL File Converter is a local Windows app built to replace sketchy online converter websites. Convert images, documents, PDFs, audio, video, and other common file types directly on your PC. No cloud uploads, forced accounts, or waiting in browser queues. It also includes multiple visual themes and a simple drag-and-drop interface designed for everyday users.

posts.name: PDFCraft
posts.tagline: PDF generation and PDF extraction. No AI in either.
posts.description: Two directions, one API key. HTML or a URL in, PDF out in ~120ms from real Chromium. PDF in, structured JSON out — tables, labelled fields, and a bounding box on every value. No OCR and no LLM, so the same document always gives the same answer.

posts.name: KeySkills - Skills for AI Agents
posts.tagline: Portable skills for AI agents
posts.description: KeySkills provides an essential suite of portable, open-source skills designed to enhance the output of high-agency AI coding agents. It addresses common issues like generic UIs, unindexed pages, sloppy commits, and bloated repositories. With a single command, users can install these focused skills. The tool integrates with popular AI coding assistants such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and GitHub Copilot, making it easy to improve AI-generated code quality.

posts.name: JobVouch
posts.tagline: Tailor resumes that pass ATS—and survive the interview
posts.description: JobVouch turns one job post into an evidence-backed application pack. Upload your resume to get an Apply Readiness score, requirement-to-proof map, missing keywords, safe rewrites, unsupported-skill warnings, PDF/DOCX export, and job-specific interview prep. It also works on LinkedIn, Indeed, and company career pages via Chrome. Your first scan and enough credits to tailor one resume end-to-end are free—no credit card.

posts.name: AIOPE
posts.tagline: An on-device AI agent for your Android phone
posts.description: AIOPE — 70-tool on-device AI agent for Android. Linux terminal, realtime voice, browser automation, SSH, on-device RAG, dynamic UI, MCP. BYOK, any model. By XNet Inc. - XNet-NGO/aiope

posts.name: Color Palette Generator - 17 Schemes
posts.tagline: 17 palettes from one color, in 8 languages
posts.description: Enter one HEX color and get 17 palettes: monochromatic, complementary, triadic, tetradic, earth tones, neon, vintage, sunset and more. Five colors each, with HEX and HSL. Copy any code in one click. Runs in your browser. Free, no signup.
